-- =================================================================
-- dim_date.sql
-- =================================================================
-- Calendar date dimension with comprehensive date attributes
-- Pre-generated date spine covering the full dataset period
-- =================================================================

with date_spine as (
    





with rawdata as (

    

    

    with p as (
        select 0 as generated_number union all select 1
    ), unioned as (

    select

    
    p0.generated_number * power(2, 0)
     + 
    
    p1.generated_number * power(2, 1)
     + 
    
    p2.generated_number * power(2, 2)
     + 
    
    p3.generated_number * power(2, 3)
     + 
    
    p4.generated_number * power(2, 4)
     + 
    
    p5.generated_number * power(2, 5)
     + 
    
    p6.generated_number * power(2, 6)
     + 
    
    p7.generated_number * power(2, 7)
     + 
    
    p8.generated_number * power(2, 8)
     + 
    
    p9.generated_number * power(2, 9)
     + 
    
    p10.generated_number * power(2, 10)
    
    
    + 1
    as generated_number

    from

    
    p as p0
     cross join 
    
    p as p1
     cross join 
    
    p as p2
     cross join 
    
    p as p3
     cross join 
    
    p as p4
     cross join 
    
    p as p5
     cross join 
    
    p as p6
     cross join 
    
    p as p7
     cross join 
    
    p as p8
     cross join 
    
    p as p9
     cross join 
    
    p as p10
    
    

    )

    select *
    from unioned
    where generated_number <= 1826
    order by generated_number



),

all_periods as (

    select (
        

    cast('2016-01-01' as date) + ((interval '1 day') * (row_number() over (order by generated_number) - 1))


    ) as date_day
    from rawdata

),

filtered as (

    select *
    from all_periods
    where date_day <= cast('2020-12-31' as date)

)

select * from filtered


),

dates as (
    select
        cast(date_day as date) as full_date
    from date_spine
)

select
    -- Primary key (integer format: YYYYMMDD)
    cast(to_char(full_date, 'YYYYMMDD') as integer)          as date_key,
    
    -- Full date
    full_date                                                 as date,
    
    -- Day attributes
    extract(isodow from full_date)::smallint                  as day_of_week,
    to_char(full_date, 'Day')                                 as day_name,
    to_char(full_date, 'Dy')                                  as day_name_short,
    extract(day from full_date)::smallint                     as day_of_month,
    extract(doy from full_date)::smallint                     as day_of_year,
    
    -- Week attributes
    extract(week from full_date)::smallint                    as week_of_year,
    to_char(full_date, 'YYYY-IW')                             as year_week,
    
    -- Month attributes
    extract(month from full_date)::smallint                   as month_number,
    to_char(full_date, 'Month')                               as month_name,
    to_char(full_date, 'Mon')                                 as month_name_short,
    to_char(full_date, 'YYYY-MM')                             as year_month,
    
    -- Quarter attributes
    extract(quarter from full_date)::smallint                 as quarter,
    'Q' || extract(quarter from full_date)::text              as quarter_name,
    extract(year from full_date)::text || '-Q' || 
        extract(quarter from full_date)::text                 as year_quarter,
    
    -- Year attributes
    extract(year from full_date)::integer                     as year,
    
    -- Date flags
    case when extract(isodow from full_date) in (6, 7)
         then true else false end                             as is_weekend,
    case when extract(isodow from full_date) not in (6, 7)
         then true else false end                             as is_weekday,
    
    -- Brazilian holidays (simplified - add more as needed)
    case
        when extract(month from full_date) = 1 and extract(day from full_date) = 1
            then true -- New Year
        when extract(month from full_date) = 9 and extract(day from full_date) = 7
            then true -- Independence Day
        when extract(month from full_date) = 11 and extract(day from full_date) = 15
            then true -- Republic Day
        when extract(month from full_date) = 12 and extract(day from full_date) = 25
            then true -- Christmas
        else false
    end as is_holiday,
    
    -- Fiscal year (assuming calendar year = fiscal year)
    extract(quarter from full_date)::smallint                 as fiscal_quarter,
    extract(year from full_date)::integer                     as fiscal_year,
    
    -- Relative date flags (useful for analytics)
    case when full_date = current_date then true else false end as is_today,
    case when full_date = current_date - 1 then true else false end as is_yesterday,
    case when date_trunc('week', full_date) = date_trunc('week', current_date)
         then true else false end as is_current_week,
    case when date_trunc('month', full_date) = date_trunc('month', current_date)
         then true else false end as is_current_month,
    case when date_trunc('quarter', full_date) = date_trunc('quarter', current_date)
         then true else false end as is_current_quarter,
    case when date_trunc('year', full_date) = date_trunc('year', current_date)
         then true else false end as is_current_year

from dates

-- dim_product.sql
-- =================================================================
-- Product dimension from Olist dataset
-- Includes product attributes, categories, and physical dimensions
-- =================================================================
-- Note: For SCD Type 2, use the product_snapshot model
-- This dimension provides current state only
-- =================================================================

with products as (
    select * from "shopflow_warehouse"."public_staging"."stg_products"
),

-- Aggregate product sales metrics
product_metrics as (
    select
        oi.product_id,
        count(distinct oi.order_id) as total_orders,
        sum(oi.price) as total_revenue,
        avg(oi.price) as avg_price,
        min(oi.price) as min_price,
        max(oi.price) as max_price,
        count(*) as total_items_sold
    from "shopflow_warehouse"."public_staging"."stg_order_items" oi
    inner join "shopflow_warehouse"."public_staging"."stg_orders" o
        on oi.order_id = o.order_id
    where o.order_status = 'delivered'
    group by oi.product_id
),

enriched as (
    select
        -- Surrogate key
        md5(cast(coalesce(cast(p.product_id as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') as TEXT)) as product_key,
        
        -- Primary business key
        p.product_id,
        
        -- Category attributes
        p.category_name,
        p.category_name_portuguese,
        
        -- Product content metrics
        p.product_name_length,
        p.product_description_length,
        p.product_photos_qty,
        p.photo_quality_tier,
        p.description_quality,
        
        -- Physical dimensions
        p.product_weight_g,
        p.product_weight_g / 1000.0 as product_weight_kg,
        p.product_length_cm,
        p.product_height_cm,
        p.product_width_cm,
        p.product_volume_cm3,
        
        -- Product flags
        p.is_uncategorized,
        case when p.product_weight_g > 10000 then true else false end as is_heavy_item,
        case when p.product_volume_cm3 > 100000 then true else false end as is_large_item,
        
        -- Sales metrics
        coalesce(m.total_orders, 0) as total_orders,
        coalesce(m.total_items_sold, 0) as total_items_sold,
        coalesce(m.total_revenue, 0) as total_revenue,
        coalesce(m.avg_price, 0) as avg_selling_price,
        coalesce(m.min_price, 0) as min_selling_price,
        coalesce(m.max_price, 0) as max_selling_price,
        
        -- Price variance (useful for detecting price changes)
        case
            when m.max_price > 0 and m.min_price > 0
            then ((m.max_price - m.min_price) / m.min_price) * 100
            else 0
        end as price_variance_pct,
        
        -- Product performance tier
        case
            when m.total_items_sold >= 50 then 'Best Seller'
            when m.total_items_sold >= 20 then 'Popular'
            when m.total_items_sold >= 5 then 'Average'
            when m.total_items_sold >= 1 then 'Slow Mover'
            else 'Never Sold'
        end as performance_tier,
        
        -- Metadata
        p.dbt_updated_at
        
    from products p
    left join product_metrics m on p.product_id = m.product_id
)

select * from enriched

-- dim_seller.sql
-- =================================================================
-- Seller dimension from Olist dataset
-- Includes seller geographic data and performance metrics
-- =================================================================

with sellers as (
    select * from "shopflow_warehouse"."public_staging"."stg_sellers"
),

-- Aggregate seller performance metrics
seller_metrics as (
    select
        oi.seller_id,
        count(distinct oi.order_id) as total_orders,
        sum(oi.price) as total_revenue,
        sum(oi.freight_value) as total_freight,
        avg(oi.price) as avg_item_price,
        count(*) as total_items_sold,
        count(distinct oi.product_id) as unique_products_sold
    from "shopflow_warehouse"."public_staging"."stg_order_items" oi
    inner join "shopflow_warehouse"."public_staging"."stg_orders" o
        on oi.order_id = o.order_id
    where o.order_status = 'delivered'
    group by oi.seller_id
),

-- Get geolocation for seller zip codes
geo as (
    select * from "shopflow_warehouse"."public_staging"."stg_geolocation"
),

enriched as (
    select
        -- Surrogate key
        md5(cast(coalesce(cast(s.seller_id as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') as TEXT)) as seller_key,
        
        -- Primary business key
        s.seller_id,
        
        -- Geographic attributes
        s.zip_code,
        s.city,
        s.state,
        g.latitude,
        g.longitude,
        
        -- Performance metrics
        coalesce(m.total_orders, 0) as total_orders,
        coalesce(m.total_items_sold, 0) as total_items_sold,
        coalesce(m.unique_products_sold, 0) as unique_products_sold,
        coalesce(m.total_revenue, 0) as total_revenue,
        coalesce(m.total_freight, 0) as total_freight,
        coalesce(m.avg_item_price, 0) as avg_item_price,
        
        -- Seller segmentation
        case
            when m.total_orders >= 100 then 'Enterprise'
            when m.total_orders >= 50 then 'Professional'
            when m.total_orders >= 10 then 'Growing'
            when m.total_orders >= 1 then 'Small'
            else 'Inactive'
        end as seller_tier,
        
        -- Product diversity score
        case
            when m.total_items_sold > 0
            then round(m.unique_products_sold::numeric / m.total_items_sold::numeric, 2)
            else 0
        end as product_diversity_score,
        
        -- Metadata
        s.dbt_updated_at
        
    from sellers s
    left join seller_metrics m on s.seller_id = m.seller_id
    left join geo g on s.zip_code = g.zip_code
)

select * from enriched

-- =================================================================
-- dim_customer.sql
-- =================================================================
-- Customer dimension from Olist dataset
-- Includes both customer_id and customer_unique_id
-- Geographic attributes from staging layer
-- =================================================================
-- Note: For SCD Type 2, use the customer_snapshot model
-- This dimension provides current state only
-- =================================================================

with customers as (
    select * from "shopflow_warehouse"."public_staging"."stg_customers"
),

-- Aggregate customer order metrics for enrichment
customer_metrics as (
    select
        o.customer_id,
        count(distinct o.order_id) as total_orders,
        min(o.order_purchase_timestamp) as first_order_date,
        max(o.order_purchase_timestamp) as last_order_date,
        count(distinct case when o.order_status = 'delivered' then o.order_id end) as delivered_orders,
        count(distinct case when o.order_status = 'canceled' then o.order_id end) as canceled_orders
    from "shopflow_warehouse"."public_staging"."stg_orders" o
    group by o.customer_id
),

-- Get geolocation data for customer zip codes
geo as (
    select * from "shopflow_warehouse"."public_staging"."stg_geolocation"
),

enriched as (
    select
        -- Surrogate key
        md5(cast(coalesce(cast(c.customer_id as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') as TEXT)) as customer_key,
        
        -- Primary business key
        c.customer_id,
        c.customer_unique_id,
        
        -- Geographic attributes
        c.zip_code,
        c.city,
        c.state,
        g.latitude,
        g.longitude,
        
        -- Order metrics
        coalesce(m.total_orders, 0) as total_orders,
        coalesce(m.delivered_orders, 0) as delivered_orders,
        coalesce(m.canceled_orders, 0) as canceled_orders,
        m.first_order_date,
        m.last_order_date,
        
        -- Customer segmentation
        case
            when m.total_orders >= 3 then 'Repeat'
            when m.total_orders = 2 then 'Second-time'
            when m.total_orders = 1 then 'One-time'
            else 'No orders'
        end as customer_segment,
        
        -- Days since last order (for churn analysis)
        case
            when m.last_order_date is not null
            then current_date - m.last_order_date::date
            else null
        end as days_since_last_order,
        
        -- Customer lifecycle status
        case
            when m.total_orders = 0 then 'Inactive'
            when current_date - m.last_order_date::date <= 90 then 'Active'
            when current_date - m.last_order_date::date <= 180 then 'At Risk'
            else 'Churned'
        end as lifecycle_status,
        
        -- Metadata
        c.dbt_updated_at
        
    from customers c
    left join customer_metrics m on c.customer_id = m.customer_id
    left join geo g on c.zip_code = g.zip_code
)

select * from enriched

-- =================================================================
-- fact_sales.sql
-- =================================================================
-- Fact table at the grain of ONE ROW PER ORDER ITEM
-- Central fact table in the star schema
-- =================================================================
-- Conforms to the dimensional model with surrogate keys to:
--   - dim_date
--   - dim_customer
--   - dim_product
--   - dim_seller
-- =================================================================

with order_items as (
    select * from "shopflow_warehouse"."public_staging"."stg_order_items"
),

orders as (
    select * from "shopflow_warehouse"."public_staging"."stg_orders"
),

-- Aggregate payments by order
order_payments as (
    select
        order_id,
        sum(payment_value) as total_payment_value,
        max(payment_type_standardized) as primary_payment_type,
        max(case when is_installment then true else false end) as has_installment,
        sum(payment_installments) as total_installments
    from "shopflow_warehouse"."public_staging"."stg_payments"
    group by order_id
),

-- Get primary review score per order
order_reviews as (
    select
        order_id,
        avg(review_score) as avg_review_score,
        max(review_score) as max_review_score,
        min(review_score) as min_review_score,
        count(*) as review_count
    from "shopflow_warehouse"."public_staging"."stg_order_reviews"
    group by order_id
),

-- Get dimension surrogate keys
dim_customer as (
    select
        customer_id,
        customer_key
    from "shopflow_warehouse"."public_marts"."dim_customer"
),

dim_product as (
    select
        product_id,
        product_key
    from "shopflow_warehouse"."public_marts"."dim_product"
),

dim_seller as (
    select
        seller_id,
        seller_key
    from "shopflow_warehouse"."public_marts"."dim_seller"
),

-- Join all components
fact as (
    select
        -- Surrogate key (unique identifier for this fact record)
        md5(cast(coalesce(cast(oi.order_id as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') || '-' || coalesce(cast(oi.order_item_id as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') as TEXT)) as sales_key,
        
        -- Foreign keys to dimensions
        cast(to_char(o.order_date, 'YYYYMMDD') as integer) as date_key,
        dc.customer_key,
        dp.product_key,
        ds.seller_key,
        
        -- Degenerate dimensions (don't warrant separate dimension tables)
        oi.order_id,
        oi.order_item_id,
        o.order_status,
        
        -- Date/Time stamps
        o.order_purchase_timestamp,
        o.order_approved_at,
        o.order_delivered_carrier_date,
        o.order_delivered_customer_date,
        o.order_estimated_delivery_date,
        o.order_date,
        o.order_year,
        o.order_month,
        o.order_quarter,
        
        -- Delivery metrics
        o.delivery_days_vs_estimate,
        o.delivered_on_time,
        
        -- Financial measures (additive facts)
        oi.price as item_price,
        oi.freight_value,
        oi.total_price,
        oi.estimated_gross_profit,
        
        -- Order-level payment info (semi-additive - need to handle aggregates carefully)
        pay.total_payment_value as order_payment_value,
        pay.primary_payment_type,
        
        -- Review metrics (non-additive - need special handling)
        rev.avg_review_score,
        rev.review_count,
        
        -- Flags
        o.is_delivered,
        o.is_canceled,
        pay.has_installment,
        
        -- Calculated metrics
        case
            when oi.price > 0
            then (oi.estimated_gross_profit / oi.price) * 100
            else 0
        end as gross_margin_pct,
        
        case
            when oi.total_price > 0
            then (oi.freight_value / oi.total_price) * 100
            else 0
        end as freight_pct_of_total,
        
        -- Shipping performance metrics
        case
            when o.order_delivered_customer_date is not null 
                 and o.order_purchase_timestamp is not null
            then extract(epoch from (
                o.order_delivered_customer_date - o.order_purchase_timestamp
            )) / 86400.0
            else null
        end as actual_delivery_days,
        
        case
            when o.order_estimated_delivery_date is not null 
                 and o.order_purchase_timestamp is not null
            then extract(epoch from (
                o.order_estimated_delivery_date - o.order_purchase_timestamp
            )) / 86400.0
            else null
        end as estimated_delivery_days,
        
        -- Metadata
        current_timestamp as dbt_updated_at
        
    from order_items oi
    inner join orders o
        on oi.order_id = o.order_id
    left join order_payments pay
        on o.order_id = pay.order_id
    left join order_reviews rev
        on o.order_id = rev.order_id
    inner join dim_customer dc
        on o.customer_id = dc.customer_id
    inner join dim_product dp
        on oi.product_id = dp.product_id
    inner join dim_seller ds
        on oi.seller_id = ds.seller_id
    
    
)
